name: – Veronika Vrecionová – Article 2, after § 2 – Am 283
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the welfare of dogs and cats and their traceability
part_text: 2 a. Notwithstanding paragraph 2 of this Article, the general welfare requirements laid down in Article 5, the prohibition of abandonment, cruelty, tethering and painful practices laid down, respectively, in Article 6(1a) and (1b), Article 14(3) and Article 15 shall apply to all dogs and cats in the Union held under the responsibility of natural persons.
